name: Sanan ST silicon carbide device fab, Chongqing

parties.name: STMicroelectronics
parties.note: The venture makes silicon carbide devices only for ST with ST's process technology, acting as a dedicated foundry for ST's customers in China.

parties.name: Sanan Optoelectronics
parties.note: Also builds and runs a separate 200 mm substrate plant to supply the venture.

summary: A 200 mm silicon carbide device fab in Chongqing set up by STMicroelectronics and Sanan Optoelectronics under a June 2023 agreement, producing automotive-grade power devices exclusively for ST. The full build-out is budgeted at about $3.2 billion. The fab formally began operations on 27 February 2025, with mass production then expected in the fourth quarter of 2025; ST reports that manufacturing started and entered ramp-up in 2026. Full build-out is planned for 2028.

metrics.note: Full build-out, including about $2.4 billion of capital expenditure over five years, financed by both partners, local government support and loans.
Total investment given at the inauguration, the yuan equivalent of the $3.2 billion build-out.

milestones.note: ST and Sanan announced their agreement to form the joint venture, subject to regulatory approvals.
Inauguration ceremony; the facility was reported to have commenced operations.
Production start targeted for the fourth quarter of 2025.
ST reports that manufacturing at the venture started and entered ramp-up in 2026.
Full build-out planned for 2028; at full operation the fab is expected to make about 10,000 automotive-grade wafers per week.
